summary: Sealing this node's batches into envelopes signs their claims and envelopes, encodes their payloads and records and hashes them on a read transaction before it takes the store's writer. Under the writer it checks that the batches, their claims, the named blobs that are stored, the stored claim signatures, the member key, the fleet id and the held keys are unchanged, then writes; a chunk whose inputs changed is prepared again. A chunk is at most 64 batches and 16 MiB of payload (one larger batch alone)

replay.detail: Sealing stores the same envelopes, records and signatures as before; projection and replay are unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing new is persisted.
